text:
incident-bot: ALERT: http_5xx_rate > 3% for service=api-gateway in prod-us-east-1 (1m window). Pager triggered. PagerID: PD12345.
Sam (oncall): acked. I'm on it, will check dashboards.
Aisha (sre): i'm toggling oncall to Sam — Sam, if you need escalation ping me.
Sam (oncall): looking at logs -> large surge of 502/504 from ingress -> majority from upstream pool 'model-proxy-v2'.
Ben (infra): just checked autoscaling metrics — node CPU/mem look fine, requests per pod spiked, readiness probe failures on some pods. Could be connection saturation.
Carlos (serving): new rollout of proxy v2 landed ~20m ago, but traffic % is small. I'll grep request traces for exceptions.
Sam (oncall): quick customer impact check — on dashboards we see error rate hitting 4.8% overall, some routes ("/v1/generate") at 12%. Top affected region us-east-1.
Leah (support): flagged two enterprise customers via high-error alert; support is standing by. Notified account owners.
Carlos (serving): traced stacktraces -> upstreams returning 502 due to HTTP/1.1 keepalive errors. Suspect connection pool exhaustion in proxy v2.
Ben (infra): can we route traffic around proxy v2? ops: we have a fallback pool 'model-proxy-v1' still healthy.
Sam (oncall): propose temporary mitigation: 1) shift a portion of traffic to proxy-v1, 2) scale proxy-v2 target connections, 3) rate-limit bursty clients. Thoughts?
Aisha (sre): +1. Also recommend setting an automatic retry/fallback at gateway layer to reduce 5xx surface area while we investigate.
Carlos (serving): implementing traffic split now. Patching envoy config in prod us-east-1: applying 80/20 split v2->v1.
Carlos (serving): config patch:
```
kubectl -n platform apply -f envoy-traffic-split-us-east1.yaml
# patch content: route /v1/generate weighted clusters: model-proxy-v2:80, model-proxy-v1:20
```
Sam (oncall): applying a temporary ingress rate-limit rule for highly frequent clients (burst window 10s). Command:
```
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap rate-limiter --patch '{"data":{"burst":"10","rate":"5/s"}}'
```
Ben (infra): scaling proxy-v2 connection pool parameters via k8s rollout restart to pick up new config. Command:
```
kubectl -n serving set env deployment/model-proxy-v2 MAX_CONN=500
kubectl -n serving rollout restart deployment/model-proxy-v2
```
Aisha (sre): Sam — keep an eye on 5xx rate and latency. If rate doesn't drop in 5m, escalate to full page and open incident room.
Sam (oncall): initial metric after split/rate limit: overall 5xx rate down to 2.1% within ~90s, /v1/generate down to 6.5%. Not fully resolved but improved.
Leah (support): customers updated: sent initial status note — "We are actively mitigating increased errors; next update in 15 minutes."
Carlos (serving): digging into proxy-v2 code paths — seeing a bug with HTTP keepalive reuse when upstream resets connections. There's a recent change in connection pooling (PR #742).
Sam (oncall): can we rollback PR 742 on proxy-v2?
Carlos (serving): yes, plan: revert the deployment to the previous image sha. Reverting now.
Carlos (serving): rollback commands:
```
kubectl -n serving rollout undo deployment/model-proxy-v2 --to-revision=3
```
Ben (infra): observed pod restarts for proxy-v2 as part of rollback, but health checks succeeding for new pods.
Sam (oncall): after rollback and traffic split, 5xx rate stabilized at 1.2% across the region. Great.
Aisha (sre): marking this as mitigated for now. We'll leave traffic split in place for 30 minutes while we monitor, then gradually shift back if stable.
Leah (support): sent second update to customers: "Errors have reduced significantly; engineers rolled back a recent proxy change and applied temporary routing rules. Monitoring continues."
Sam (oncall): taking notes for post-incident: root cause likely connection pooling regression from PR #742 in proxy-v2 leading to upstream resets -> 502/504. Mitigations: rollback PR, traffic split, ingress rate-limits, adjust MAX_CONN.
Carlos (serving): opening a follow-up ticket: SERV-987 - "Investigate connection pooling bug in model-proxy-v2 (PR #742)" and will include trace samples.
Aisha (sre): assign action items: Carlos to own SERV-987, Ben to add horizontal autoscaling cushion for proxy-v2, Sam to run a post-mortem draft.
Sam (oncall): handing off to Aisha for next shift — I'm going offline for the rotation. Summary for next oncall: mitigations applied (rollback, rate-limits, 80/20 traffic split), current 5xx ~1.0-1.5%, watchlist: proxy-v2 pod restarts, customer error tickets.
Aisha (sre): acknowledged handoff. I'll watch next 30m and coordinate postmortem.
incident-bot: Pager PD12345 marked as resolved (ack: Sam, resolved-by: Carlos)
Leah (support): closing customer updates thread for now, will reopen if errors reappear.
Sam (oncall): thanks team :tada: — great quick coordination.
Aisha (sre): adding timeline and logs to SERV-987; will ping owners for root cause review in 24h.
Leah (support): marking customers as "aware" in CRM and leaving note about rollback.
Carlos (serving): dropping a link to traces: https://observability.company/traces/trace/abcd1234
Sam (oncall): final note: no data loss, degraded responses only. Will complete incident report tomorrow.
Aisha (sre): closing the thread, will re-open if metrics regress
